context: A doctor and a teacher discuss school health screening logistics
purpose: Teach: 肉体/体質/視覚/恐ろしい/強烈/蓄積/高等/必然

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 斎藤先生、来週の高等部の健康診断ですが、視覚検査の手順を確認させてください。
lines.en: Dr. Saito, regarding next week's health screening for the high school division, I'd like to confirm the visual examination procedure.
lines.style: Polite, professional teacher addressing a doctor formally.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。視覚だけでなく、肉体の発達状況も合わせて見ますので、生徒には体操服での待機をお願いします。
lines.en: Yes. We'll be examining not only vision but also their physical development, so please have the students wait in their gym clothes.
lines.style: Calm, methodical doctor explaining clinical procedure clearly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: わかりました。最近アレルギー体質の子が増えている気がするのですが、何か対策は必要でしょうか?
lines.en: Understood. I get the sense that more children have allergic constitutions lately—are any countermeasures necessary?
lines.style: Concerned teacher raising a practical health question politely.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ、現代の食生活ではアレルゲンの蓄積が問題でして、強烈な反応を起こす子もいます。事前申告の書類を配ってください。
lines.en: Yes, with modern diets the accumulation of allergens is an issue, and some children have intense reactions. Please distribute the pre-declaration forms.
lines.style: Doctor giving evidence-based medical guidance with measured tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本当に恐ろしい話ですね。保護者にもしっかり周知します。
lines.en: That's truly a frightening matter. I'll make sure the guardians are properly informed as well.
lines.style: Teacher reacting with genuine concern, then reassuring tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。スクリーニング項目を増やせば、異常を早期発見できるのは必然の結果ですから。
lines.en: Thank you. If we expand the screening items, early detection of abnormalities is a necessary outcome.
lines.style: Doctor reinforcing rationale with confident, logical phrasing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: では当日は受付を二か所に分けて、混雑を避ける形でよろしいですか?
lines.en: Then on the day itself, shall we split the reception into two locations to avoid congestion?
lines.style: Teacher proposing a logistical solution in collaborative manner.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: それで結構です。看護師も二名連れてきますので、スムーズに進められるはずです。
lines.en: That will be fine. I'll bring two nurses along, so it should proceed smoothly.
lines.style: Doctor confirming the plan with reassuring, cooperative voice.
